notes.title: The Basic Campaigns Pack is finally LIVE!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/fee717b6a9bad2d3b4f1388f5e6fa9566eec7d32.jpg

Hello everybody,
we have finally released the basic campaign pack, which completes the initial version of the game with the infinite triple adventure.

This DLC finally completes the planned game's series of THREE basic campaigns, enriching it with new scenarios, objects, obstacles and above all new goals that are more difficult to score.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/294f7aa880842fa7cbadb377f10618331f7548de.jpg

These contents complete the BASE version of the game, waiting for the great future DLCs!
This pack contains two fantastic basic add-on campaigns, with new scenarios and dynamics:

- Grassland 1
- Tropical 1

Grassland 1
This campaign is set on the grassland, with bright moving objects and goals with a big central obstacle, to make it more difficult for the ball to enter!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/afc44ce7de7007bdccd957e2b42d5774f73e4c5a.jpg

Tropical 1
This campaign is set on a tropical island, with rusted and metallic objects. Goals have TRIPLE big obstacles to make the challenge to score even better!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/7a1355aaba9aea22f825434c9a737399d8beb3ca.jpg

Activation
Once this DLC is purchased, these locked game campaigns can be played with the 'Start!' Button.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/888e3bb3f4277206d16ea709af997a60dc7dec34.jpg

notes.title: The state of the art and our roadmap
notes.content:
Hello everybody,
last year was full of problems for us, including organizational ones.
We've also had to change a lot of game-related choices, but we are PROUD to have released version 1.0 on Steam!

We want to tell you that this is a starting point for us, the foundations for making the game we had in mind at the beginning, a game that is varied, broad and full of surprises and fun content.

In fact, now we have restructured the game so that it has a very easy to manage and very expandable structure, and these are the two big paths we want to take:

- great variety of multiple campaigns, with always different objects, obstacles, goals, balls and game modes.

- enhancement and expansion of online game statistics and comparison / competition with players, perhaps using the powerful and famous liveOps tools for games.
In fact, we would like to enhance the online part of the game.

We are a small group with a great passion and unfortunately we are not marketing experts, so we really hope for your participation and your advice as players, so that we can build this game together!
And we hope this truly becomes the game we had in mind, and we hope to take this journey with you.

A greeting,
Blue Aura Games

notes.title: OMG - One More Goal - The full version 1.0 available now!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
it was a long journey, but in the end we managed to reach the goal: OMG - One More Goal has reached its final version 1.0!

In this latest mega-update the game has been completely rebuilt in all its parts, and has been made much more fluid, commercial and fun.

[previewyoutube=ZjRELdeNUr4;full][/previewyoutube]
Below we list all the news of version 1.0, hoping you like them!

New visual style
All the graphics in the game have been redesigned. Now the style is much more cheerful and cartoon style; lighting is more powerful and voxel technology has been abandoned to use simpler and more manageable structures.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/69ab76831bb8427d166f9560fa683a57d414c2bf.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/c1a2a9fcc1de92481bb14b52c645a724e9be1aa0.jpg

New procedural generation of levels
The random generation of levels has been completely overhauled. Voxel technology is no longer used but a much more flexible and simple structure is now used.
The vegetation and trees are created in a more orderly and clear way.
Dynamic obstacles have also been revised and are now procedurally generated based on levels. Trees and obstacles increase as you progress through the game campaign, creating an increasingly beautiful and unpredictable challenge.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/0f99e0546b62af0c12548a2e1c49d162de173bb5.jpg

New GUI
The whole graphic interface of the game has been completely rewritten, to be more readable, cheerful and commercial.
The in-game GUI has also been completely revised to use much more readable and clear cartoon effects.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/9949080ab5e060f74070ea17a281a77cfb28601e.jpg
New game statistics
The game statistics have been revised and modified, removing the less important ones and inserting those fundamental for the game dynamics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/141e1c74da8328a8ff8d0381d4043433bd27a129.jpg
New scoring system
The scoring system has also been completely revised.
We've added new rewards, new level stats, and additional scores now also take into account campaign difficulty, time played and actual match time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/15176b8edcdb0a2eefc2366f41b43f107c6ec822.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/2684a66675214e0dbd0938fa52cb03bfc4e44923.jpg
New multiple online leaderboards
Based on the new game statistics, the online rankings on Steam have also been changed, to have an increasingly fun and competitive challenge with other players from around the world!

Three endless game campaigns
With this full version of the game which has a new procedural generation of levels, vegetation and obstacles, only three main game campaigns have been maintained for now:
Forest, Grassland and Tropical.
In fact, the new game mechanics allow for guaranteed fun with these campaigns.
The standard edition of the game has the single Forest 1 campaign, the others are available as DLC.
Each campaign has different types of goals and obstacles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/0b199fb36a613af63882b3f8f02df7f15c486cb2.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/aa326b028df8d207ebea4520ad6dd2bdd6a80ee2.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/5b2ff692a4226a0d4737a422558a9c60ea114ebb.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/bd879f221f789f2598a65cbe73ed5e62a65a336b.jpg

We hope you enjoy the full game!

notes.title: OMG - One More Goal early access, out now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/6ab219ed00c4c6a669b7e9681c67da0aa61c2449.png
Hello everyone,
finally our game is available in early access, for us begins a new adventure with you!

OMG - One More Goal is an action-fighting game with soccer dynamics.
The controls are immediate, the gameplay is intuitive, the levels are always random and unpredictable.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/c6c807e30d4c301378a2516aac9726ebdd7fec22.jpg
We decided to go out in early access because we want to build the game with you players, we want to listen to and read all of your suggestions or wishes, so that we can actually create what you want and have fun there!

GAME POTENTIAL
The game is designed for these great features:
- fully configurable player number
- fully configurable player characteristics (speed, responsiveness, aggressiveness, shot and pass power)
- fully configurable goalkeeper features (speed, responsiveness, aggressiveness, shot and pass power)
- infinite variety of goals
- infinite variety of balls
- infinite variety of scenarios and obstacles
- infinite variety of weapons
- large variety of game modes
- online saving of any data (players, scores, rankings and much more)
- complete liveOps online

We really hope you like the game, a big greeting from Blue Aura Games!
[previewyoutube=bj9pE4WESZw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: OMG - One More Goal! Coming soon on Steam Early Access!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/5c42585c8fcbf9e41b7603eb4f25fbddb134a460.png

Hello everyone,
we are very happy to tell you that our game will be released on Steam soon in early access!

During development we realized that the product was already playable and fun, with a complete management of the game modes and three infinite procedural campaigns.

We thought about it a lot and in the end we decided to make the game available on Steam in early access, in order to get in touch with the public as soon as possible and begin our adventure with the players.
We think this can be a nice experience for us and them.

We have also already activated the online leaderboards, so that players can already compete with each other.

State of art

The game is currently at alpha version 0.6.0.
For now there are only three game campaigns, complete management of game statistics and main options.
The main game logic has been implemented with a first simple AI for NPCs.
These three campaigns have procedurally generated levels and are infinite, for now these use the same 'ball' and the same ammo for the players.

Multiple online rankings are already active and the control system is the definitive one. By this way players can already have fun and compete with each other, experiencing the gameplay.
In the future there will be many other game campaigns with new objects and variants, a complete management of the online 'backend' and a more developed 'social' features.

There is therefore now the game's 'core engine', playable and fun!

[previewyoutube=bj9pE4WESZw;full][/previewyoutube]
